# Results tables (generated by scripts/analyze_results.py from results/results.csv)

## Table 1: Limits found in the real service (computed from probe-* rows)

| Limit | Value found | How found | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Requests per minute | 30 OK, then a 429 | probe-rpm: tiny calls back to back until the first 429 | high |
| Tokens per minute | 8000 (header); 429 after 3 large calls | x-ratelimit-limit-tokens on every response + probe-tpm | high |
| Requests per day | 1000 (header) | x-ratelimit-limit-requests; remaining drops by 1 per call | high |
| Tokens per day | not observed (documented 200K) | never reached; no header reports it | low |
| Requests in flight at once | 10 of 10 succeeded at once (626–787 ms) | probe-concurrency | medium (only 10 tried) |
| What it returns at a limit | HTTP 429 in 60 ms, retry-after 2 s (2 429s seen) | probe rows with status rate_limited | high |
| Time until it recovers | 2,072 ms (TPM), 3,180 ms (RPM) after the first 429 | next successful call after the 429 | medium (one episode each) |
